# Buho Store

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Uruguayan online store selling home organization and decor: organizers, baskets, shelves, textiles, kitchen and bath accessories, tableware, lighting and candles. Ships nationwide with store pickup in Montevideo.
